subject.title: 🐛 stocks: 734k unidades vendidas con soldAt vacío (histórico 2021-2025 + goteo residual)

question: How should `soldAt` be represented for `SOLD_AS_ALTERNATIVE` rows before fixing and backfilling this issue?
rationale: The plain `SOLD` leak has a clear existing contract, but replacement stocks can either inherit the order marketplace or need distinct attribution, and the backfill will persist that choice across historical data.

options.title: Fix SOLD first, decide alternatives separately
options.body: Prevent generic `SOLD` withdrawals without marketplace attribution and backfill recoverable `SOLD` rows, while leaving `SOLD_AS_ALTERNATIVE` for an explicit follow-up decision.

options.title: Backfill alternatives from order marketplace
options.body: Treat replacement-stock sales as marketplace sales and populate `soldAt` from the linked order for both future and recoverable historical alternative rows.

options.title: Add separate alternative attribution
options.body: Keep `soldAt` as the original sold-stock marketplace field and introduce a distinct field or reporting rule for replacement-stock attribution.

recommendation.title: Fix SOLD first, decide alternatives separately
recommendation.body: Prevent generic `SOLD` withdrawals without marketplace attribution and backfill recoverable `SOLD` rows, while leaving `SOLD_AS_ALTERNATIVE` for an explicit follow-up decision.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn already framed the unresolved `SOLD_AS_ALTERNATIVE` choice in triage and recently touched the stock sale marketplace path.
